thread:
alex: paging: latency alerts for /v1/generate — customers seeing 500ms -> 3s tail in eu-west-1. alerting kicked off at 12:03 UTC. incident-bot: Pager triggered: HIGH /v1/generate p95 latency > 1.2s in eu-west-1 (count=18).
priya: I'm primary on shift, grabbing it. sam are you available as secondary?
alex: yes i'm around, hopping in. first step: confirm if this is model-side CPU saturation or networking.
priya: checking infra dashboards — GPU utilization looks normal on dedicated pools; however one host shows repeated retransmits on eth0. tails: 
```
netstat -s | grep retransmit
---
TCP: retransmit packets: 124
```

sam: hmm could be a noisy neighbor causing general slow packets. any recent deploys? ops-bot: Deployer: canary rollout completed for model-server v2.7.1 at 11:58 UTC. No rollbacks.
lisa: I saw a spike in client retries too, possibly retry storm from SDK. alex: good to know. priya, can you attach the runbook steps for network-related latency?
priya: runbook snippet: 
1) identify hosts with >5% packet loss in last 10m
2) cordon host from pool: `rbctl pool remove-host --pool=dedicated-eu --host=ip-10-2-3-4`
3) route traffic to backup pool and monitor p95
4) if issue persists, rollback canary `deployer rollback model-server v2.7.1`

alex: I'm seeing host ip-10-2-3-4 has 12% retransmits and repeated MTU errors. I'll cordon it.
ops-bot: Command executed by alex: `rbctl pool remove-host --pool=dedicated-eu --host=ip-10-2-3-4` — success. :white_check_mark:
priya: after cordon, p95 dropped to 480ms, errors reduced. still a few spikes but overall improving.
sam: nice. any customer-impacting alerts we should notify support about?
lisa: customer-impact: a handful of requests from three mid-market customers saw >2s responses between 12:02-12:08 UTC. I've filed ticket INC-4927 for customer notifications and attached logs.
alex: please add the mitigation steps and timing to the ticket (cordon at 12:07 UTC) and set priority P2.
lisa: added note and set P2.
priya: handoff: my shift ends in 45m. alex will be primary for the next 8h, sam on secondary overnight. alex/sam confirm?
alex: confirmed primary for next 8h. sam confirmed secondary.
sam: I'll watch alerts at top of hour and take first escalation.
priya: coverage gap: 02:00-03:00 UTC there's no on-call overlap with APAC team — can we arrange peer coverage if a cross-region issue occurs? alex: I'll ping platform-asia to set a wake-on-call if we get another paging window. :phone: @platform-asia
incident-bot: Reminder: create a retrospective if incident >30m or customer P2.
priya: incident duration 05m from page to cordon; impact window ~06m but customer-facing latency peaked for ~6 minutes — still qualifies for short postmortem. scheduling retrospective for tomorrow 09:30 UTC. invite: alex, priya, sam, lisa, networking, deploy-team.
alex: action items: (1) ops to investigate root cause on ip-10-2-3-4 NIC firmware + switch logs (owner: sam, ticket NET-214). (2) Deploy team to add health-check to canary that watches kernel retransmit counts before promotion (owner: lisa, ticket DEP-785). (3) On-call runbook update: add step to pre-check canary host NIC error counters (owner: priya, doc: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall-network).
sam: created NET-214, linked logs and switch port flaps.
lisa: created DEP-785 and added proposed health-check pseudo-code.
priya: quick note for handoff: if a latency pager fires and dedicated pool shows one host with >10% retransmits, cordon immediately and set traffic-weight to backup pool. leaving full instructions in #oncall-runbooks.
alex: thanks — I'll follow up on the retrospective and make sure we close tickets. passing primary to alex now. priya signing off.
priya: signing off :wave: — good work team.
alex: taking over as primary. I'll keep monitoring for next 2h then hand to oncall-night.
incident-bot: Incident closed: HIGH /v1/generate latency — state: mitigated. Duration: 00:06:15.
ops-bot: Auto-create: post-incident note INC-4927 updated with mitigation timeline and action items.
sam: small follow-up: put network-health metric on main oncall dashboard (owner: sam).
lisa: i'll present DEP-785 health-check at next ops sync.
alex: wrap: retrospective scheduled, tickets: NET-214, DEP-785, INC-4927. coverage note: ask platform-asia for optional wake-on-call during 02:00-03:00 UTC. good handoff. :thumbsup:
